statement: Conditioning raises each atom relative to its unconditioned product-Poisson probability, giving -log pi_G(x0)<=C_Theta W(1+log W) from the conserved mass bound. Nonreversible L2 contraction uses the same symmetric Dirichlet form, so TV(P_T(x0,.),pi_G)<=0.5*pi_G(x0)^(-1/2) exp[-T/(C_Theta(1+W)^(D+A+2))]. Above the resulting explicit polynomial-numeric-W threshold, the paid binary equilibrium sampler gives an entire-TV endpoint approximation after allocating both errors. At early times T*Q(x0)<=epsilon, returning x0 is valid and TV-accurate; Q is the exact original initial total rate computed by fixed-arity rational arithmetic. These two complete windows do not construct the intermediate-time transition law, do not lump aggregate transient dynamics and do not accelerate an arbitrary physical path.
